title: FetchOutcomeNdjsonRecord
description:
One NDJSON record emitted by `rwv fetch --json -j N` with `N > 1`.

Each per-repo outcome becomes its own self-describing line. Every record carries its own `$schema` URL (pointing at `fetch-record.json`) so consumers can identify a line without out-of-band context. Serialised with `#[serde(flatten)]` so the wire shape is a single flat object: `{"$schema": "...", "path": "...", ...}`.

`$schema` names `docs/reference/schemas/fetch-record.json`, not the envelope artifact (`fetch.json`), because the two documents have different shapes: the envelope wraps an `outcomes` array; each streamed line is one flat per-repo object.

files.description: How the files the fetch rewrote were placed: cloned from another workspace of the repository, or written by the VCS. Absent when the fetch moved nothing or the VCS cannot say.

FilePlacement.description: How a member's tracked files reached a workspace.

hardlinked.description: Linked to another workspace's read-only copy.

reflinked.description: Cloned from another workspace's copy, sharing its storage until either is written.

written.description: Written by the version control system.
